# GitHub Copilot Instructions

[AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) is the source of truth for repository-wide guidance.
Follow it for all work in this repository.

This file is intentionally limited to GitHub Copilot-specific behavior. Do not
copy general repository conventions into it; update `AGENTS.md` instead.

When the user supplies an `@file` reference, inspect that file before deciding
what to change. In GitHub Copilot Chat, keep diagnostic excerpts focused on the
relevant failure instead of requesting or repeating complete logs.
